title: Plastic with enzymes that dissolves in the deep sea
resumen: Universidad de Tokio y JAMSTEC incrustaron enzimas en poliésteres compostables: a 757 m se degradaron casi por completo en cinco meses.

sources.cita_corta: Huang, Q. et al. (2026). Enzyme-embedded polyesters for accelerated biodegradation in the deep sea. Nature.
